title: Private Deployments - Weekly Update (2026-07-27)
content:
Summary:
This week (2026-07-20 -> 2026-07-24) focused on three parallel tracks: VPC peering and networking hardening for recent installs, two on-prem customer installs with hardware/driver compatibility issues, and finishing the private control-plane rollout for the 1.7.0 release. We had multiple customer blockers that required cross-team escalation (SRE, security, and infra).

Highlights:
- Released private-control-plane v1.7.0 to staging clusters; smoke tests passed for standard configs. (Lena)
- Resolved persistent KV cache corruption on customer testbed by rolling back a kernel-level change and applying a targeted patch. (Marcus)
- Identified root cause of failed GPU initialization on two on-prem installs: mismatched NVIDIA driver and container runtime (nvidia-driver 520 vs expected 535 and outdated containerd). (Diego)

Customer Blockers (open):
1) Acme Health (enterprise, VPC install) — blocker: VPC peering failing intermittently with route flaps.
   - Symptoms: Peering flows establish then drop after 10-30 minutes; RPC timeouts to control-plane observed.
   - Investigation: Network team captured BGP resets between customer transit GW and our peering endpoint; CIDR summary overlap plus MTU mismatch flagged.
   - Current action: SRE requested traceroute/MRT capture from customer (RDW-4578). Security asked for verification of shared subnets.
   - Owner: Priya Verma (Customer Success) / Diego to assist networking.
   - ETA for fix: 2026-07-29 (dependent on customer scheduling for maintenance window).

2) Glacier Logistics (on-prem) — blocker: GPU nodes not initializing; driver mismatch and container runtime errors.
   - Symptoms: nvidia-smi fails inside host; k3s shows pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff.
   - Root cause: Customer image uses NVIDIA driver 520; our runtime expects 535+ and the containerd config is pre-1.6.
   - Workaround: Provide patched AMI + migration plan to upgrade containerd and drivers; temporary fallback to CPU-only pool for low-priority traffic.
   - Owner: Diego Martinez; SRE on-call assisting with driver install script.
   - ETA for mitigation: 2026-07-30.

3) FinBank (private on-prem, regulated) — blocker: KMS/HSM integration failing FIPS mode tests during key import.
   - Symptoms: HSM rejects key wrap requests; logs show unsupported cipher negotiation.
   - Investigation: Security found a configuration mismatch in TLS cipher suites negotiated between our control-plane and customer HSM.
   - Action items: Security to propose allowed cipher set; infra to prepare a patch to enable alternate TLS handshake.
   - Owner: Marcus Cole (Security Liaison).
   - ETA: tentative 2026-08-03 pending customer certification window (RDW-4632).

Internal Work & Progress:
- v1.7.0 rollout: staging -> limited production canary started (10% traffic). No regression in latency/throughput that exceeds SLO so far. Remaining tasks: canary monitoring dashboard finalization and automated rollback test. (Lena)
- Install automation: improved install script for on-prem (installer v2) that validates driver/runtime and performs preflight suggestions. Beta tested with two customers; pushing to repo. (Diego)
- Docs: updated private-install runbook with new checks for MTU, BGP timers, and KMS cipher expectations. (Samira)

Standup notes (selected days):
- Mon 2026-07-20:
  - Diego: Debugging Glacier nodes; created driver install script; plan to schedule remote hands with customer Thursday.
  - Lena: v1.7.0 smoke passed; will start canary.
  - Marcus: KMS issue triage for FinBank; requested HSM vendor logs.

- Tue 2026-07-21:
  - Diego: Driver patch validated in lab; confirmed containerd upgrade steps.
  - Priya: Working with Acme Health network team to gather BGP logs.
  - Samira: Updated runbook and posted initial notes to Confluence.

- Wed 2026-07-22:
  - Diego + SRE: Remote session scheduled with Glacier for Thu 07/23.
  - Lena: Canary at 10% health check OK; watch for tail latencies.
  - Marcus: Security proposed cipher set to customer; waiting ack.

- Thu 2026-07-23:
  - Onsite remote hands for Glacier; driver upgrade completed on two nodes, third node failed due to kernel mismatch — escalated to infra.
  - Acme Health provided traceroutes; working with their network vendor to pin BGP timers.

- Fri 2026-07-24:
  - Kernel mismatch resolution plan created (kernel upgrade vs node replacement).
  - Canary extended to 25% after no regressions.
  - Action: prepare postmortem template if Acme Health incident escalates.

Decisions & Risks:
- Decision: postpone automatic kernel-level changes in installer v2; require explicit opt-in for kernel upgrades due to customer risk appetite.
- Risk: If multiple on-prem installs require kernel upgrades during business hours, we may face scheduling delays and prolonged reduced performance. Mitigation: provide temporary CPU fallback and prioritize critical path nodes.

Action items (owner -> due):
- Priya Verma -> Coordinate Acme Health maintenance window & confirm BGP timer changes (due 2026-07-29).
- Diego Martinez -> Deliver Glacier driver+containerd migration plan and AMI; run final smoke tests (due 2026-07-30).
- Marcus Cole -> Provide security-approved TLS cipher set and patch PR for control-plane (due 2026-07-31).
- Lena Fischer -> Finalize canary monitoring dashboards and automated rollback tests for v1.7.0 (due 2026-07-29).
- Samira Patel -> Publish updated runbook and checklist to Confluence; link to installer v2 PR (due 2026-07-28).

Notes for next week:
- Prioritize customer-facing fixes (Acme, Glacier, FinBank) and ensure we have clear rollback plans for any invasive steps.
- Schedule a cross-functional incident review if Acme Health peering isn't resolved by 2026-07-30.
- Continue automation of preflight checks in installer v2; aim to reduce manual pre-install triage by 50% by end of August.

Appendix: Useful links and logs:
- RDW-4578 (Acme Health VPC peering) — network logs attached in Jira.
- RDW-4632 (FinBank HSM) — security logs and vendor transcript.
- Installer v2 PR: GitHub:repo/private-deployments#112

Workload summary (this week):
- Tickets opened: 6 (2 high, 3 medium, 1 low)
- Tickets closed: 3
- Deploys: private-control-plane v1.7.0 staged + canary

If you need any specific logs or want to join the postmortem, ping me or add to the RDW tickets.

— Samira Patel, eng-private-deployments
